hitPolygonMethod: Largest actual alpha>128 contour, 4px polyline simplification; complete full-canvas coordinates. No invented body points.
safeTextBoundaryMethod: Actual leftmost nonzero figure pixel minus 64px of margin; individual pose only.
contactShadowObservation: Separate normal source-over RGBA contact residual from original mother, limited to explicit sock/seat and skirt-hip/seat polygons and <=3 source pixels from body alpha. No floor-shoe shadow in actor. Generated clean BG explicitly erases original body/contact shadows before movement; no synthetic ellipse/multiply/floor patch.
travelReason: Compact hips, knees and socked feet all supported by the same bench cushion. Candidate short tangent range is +/-12.288px only; floor loafers stay fixed in BG. Seat edge locally about 0.09 vertical/horizontal.
groundMeaning: Contact of sock feet with bench cushion; not a fictitious floor foot.
runtime: Not registered or exercised. Pending primary layer/geometry/Stage review.

endpointEvidence.method: Pillow static full-resolution BG -> normalRGBA source contact residual -> originalRGB figure. Exact dx +/-12.288, dy +/-1.10592 inspection transforms only, not browser/Electron drag evidence.
